features.text: ESSENTIAL RECOVERY SUPPORT: Short walker stabilizes foot and ankle for sprains, fractures, and post op care.
ADJUSTABLE STRAP CONTROL: Customizable compression adapts to swelling and dressings.
BREATHABLE AIRMESH LINER: Improves airflow and comfort during extended wear.
ROCKER BOTTOM GAIT: Dual axis sole promotes a more natural stride while healing.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PDAC APPROVED L4387, L4386: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
